name: SD: University intake and progression (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A university's student records, counted every week: applications under review, admitted students waiting to start, first-, second- and final-year students, graduates, and free rooms in halls. Every student who enrols takes a room in halls (a co-flow), and rooms are freed and made ready again over the year, so at the start of term the rooms can run out and hold enrolment back. The data is generated by a system dynamics model of the university (the ground truth is in sd-university/truth.model.json, including a group of students the records do not show), so discovery can be checked exactly. Changes to the university's places are announced as eras; the rest of the year's rhythm is not. Import history or Start, then Discover flows.
